description.en: Mateus Cardoso Cabral is a Senior AI Engineer and full stack developer with 13 years of experience, based in Fortaleza, Brazil (UTC-3) and working remotely. He builds LLM, RAG and multi-agent features on top of React, TypeScript, Node.js, Java/Spring Boot and AWS, and has worked for SkipTheDishes (Canada), Qualicorp and Banco do Nordeste.
description.pt: Mateus Cardoso Cabral é Engenheiro de IA Sênior e desenvolvedor full stack com 13 anos de experiência, em Fortaleza (CE) e trabalhando remoto. Cria soluções com LLMs, RAG e sistemas multiagente sobre React, TypeScript, Node.js, Java/Spring Boot e AWS, com passagens pela SkipTheDishes (Canadá), Qualicorp e Banco do Nordeste.
description.es: Mateus Cardoso Cabral es Ingeniero de IA Senior y desarrollador full stack con 13 años de experiencia, en Fortaleza, Brasil (UTC-3), trabajando en remoto.
